question: Should skill discovery, installation, inspection, publishing, and local-management commands move under the existing singular `clawhub skill` group or a new plural `clawhub skills` group, and how long should top-level aliases remain supported?
rationale: This changes the public CLI contract and terminology; source inspection can establish the inconsistency but cannot choose the permanent namespace or acceptable deprecation window.

options.title: Extend `clawhub skill`
options.body: Make the existing singular group canonical and preserve top-level commands as deprecated compatibility aliases for a defined release window.

options.title: Add `clawhub skills`
options.body: Introduce the requested plural group as canonical while aliasing both the current singular group and affected top-level commands during migration.

options.title: Keep the current layout
options.body: Retain top-level skill workflows and reserve groups for publishing or package-specific operations, documenting the distinction explicitly.

recommendation.title: Extend `clawhub skill`
recommendation.body: Make the existing singular group canonical and preserve top-level commands as deprecated compatibility aliases for a defined release window.

likelyOwner.reason: Their issue authorship, milestone action, and prior merged history on the affected CLI surface make them the strongest available routing candidate for this product choice.
